name: TOMAR Electronics, Inc.
old_description: TOMAR designs and manufactures signaling, illumination, and control systems trusted by plant managers, first responders, fleet operators, and public safety professionals around the world. Since 1969, we’ve proudly served the emergency, industrial, preemption, off-road, and custom OEM markets with a relentless commitment to quality, innovation, and excellence.
about:
TOMAR Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1969 in Chicago, Illinois, initially producing industrial warning equipment for heavy industry. The company is now headquartered in Gilbert, Arizona, and remains a family-owned and operated private business.

TOMAR designs and manufactures signaling, illumination, and control systems across five divisions: Automotive (visual and audible signaling, illumination, and optical preemption for mobile fleets including fire apparatus, police cruisers, and ambulances), Off-Road (LED light bars, illumination bars, and infrared systems for tactical and military use), Traffic (optical preemption and intersection control solutions for municipalities and traffic engineers), Industrial (strobes, sirens, beacons, and perimeter safety lighting for manufacturing, mining, warehousing, transportation hubs, and energy facilities), and Custom OEM (custom-engineered lighting and control systems, private-labeled devices, and ODM development for robotics, heavy equipment, and defense platforms). All products are engineered and assembled at the company's Gilbert facility, which houses a 100-foot automated photometric light tunnel, goniometer, spectroradiometer, Faraday cage for EMI/EMC testing, environmental chambers, and a full in-house test lab.

The company serves plant managers, first responders, fleet operators, and public safety professionals worldwide. Its customer base spans emergency services, municipal government, traffic engineering, industrial manufacturing, mining, energy, military and defense, off-road vehicle operators, marine, robotics, and heavy equipment OEMs.

TOMAR emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, 100% burn-in testing, statistical process control, and industry-leading warranties as quality differentiators. Since 2009 it has operated as an SRP Energy Star-rated manufacturer, powered by a 100 kW rooftop solar array, and pursues climate-conscious operations including energy load shifting and robust recycling.
